# Spence School

> Spence School is an independent K-12 institution offering a comprehensive academic program with detailed admissions information and grade-specific curriculum details.

Spence School serves prospective families and current students through detailed information about its K-12 academic program, admissions process, and grade-level curricula. The school emphasizes a structured approach to education from kindergarten through high school with specialized programs across lower, middle, and upper divisions.

## Key Topics

- K-12 Academic Program
- Independent School
- School Admissions
- Application Process
- Enrollment
- Lower School
- Middle School
- Elementary Education
- Curriculum Overview
- Prospective Families
- Tuition and Financial Aid
- Campus Visits
- School Curriculum
- Admissions Events
- Grade-Level Programs

## Admissions

- [Admissions Overview](https://www.spenceschool.org/admissions/admissions-overview): Detailed admissions overview and enrollment information for Spence School
- [Application Process](https://www.spenceschool.org/admissions/application-process): Step-by-step guide to Spence School's K-12 application process
- [Why Spence](https://www.spenceschool.org/admissions/why-spence): Overview of Spence School's unique offerings and educational philosophy
- [Tuition and Financial Aid](https://www.spenceschool.org/admissions/tuition-and-financial-aid): Tuition costs and financial aid options for Spence School enrollment
- [Admissions Events](https://www.spenceschool.org/admissions/admissions-events): Upcoming admissions events and campus visit opportunities at Spence
- [Inquire](https://www.spenceschool.org/admissions/inquire): Inquiry form for prospective students and families interested in Spence

- [K-12 Academic Program](https://www.spenceschool.org/academic-program/k-12-academic-program): Detailed K-12 academic program curriculum and departments at Spence
